scripts.build: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && npm run build -w @wholesale/api && npm run build -w @wholesale/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wholesale/api && npm run typecheck -w @wholesale/web && npm run typecheck:ops
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && node scripts/run-ts.mjs packages/db/seed.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && node scripts/run-ts.mjs tests/integration.ts
scripts.test:phase1: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && node scripts/run-ts.mjs tests/phase1-integration.ts
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:launch: npm run build -w @wholesale/shared && node scripts/run-ts.mjs tests/launch-integration.ts
